name: mayflower-web
description: engine.js is an ES module. Node infers module type from the nearest package.json, and without this it reads the .js extension as CommonJS and refuses the named exports. Node 22 and later guess correctly from the syntax; 20 does not, and CI runs the differential test on both. The report inlines this source and republishes it as window.MayflowerEngine, so nothing in the browser path depends on the declaration.
